stops.stop: Washington, overturned and then settled
stops.date_confidence: both events attested by Wikipedia's 'United States v. Microsoft Corp.': the D.C. This stop is dated to the settlement and carries the appellate reversal in its campa; the appellate court's criticism of Jackson's contacts with the press is standard reporting of the opinion and was not read from the opinion itself in this pass.
